message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant set fire unintentionally while using fire for ancestor tomb sweeping, causing forest fire, destroying forest land. Likely "过失毁灭森林罪" (negligent destruction of forest). Under Chinese Criminal Law Article 338 (formerly 338? Actually Article 338 of Criminal Law: "过失毁灭森林罪" - causing forest fire by negligence, causing loss of forest resources, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment, etc.) Also could be "放火罪" (arson) but requires intentional. Since it's unintentional, it's negligence. So charge: 过失毁灭森林罪.

Thus answer: [罪名]过失毁灭森林罪<eoa>
